BP.name: Blood Pressure Check
BP.description: Requires upright seated posture with uncrossed legs and arm supported at heart level.

rules.name: Upright Spine (No Slouching)
rules.description: Torso/spine angle relative to vertical axis must be within safe limits.
rules.visualMessage: Sit up straight against the backrest

rules.name: Uncrossed Legs & Level Knees
rules.description: Knees and ankles must not cross or overlap.
rules.visualMessage: Uncross your legs and keep feet flat on the floor

rules.name: Arm at Heart Level
rules.description: Active measuring arm (elbow and wrist) must be aligned with heart/chest level.
rules.visualMessage: Rest your arm on the table at heart level

rules.name: Head & Neck Neutral
rules.description: Head should not droop forward excessively.
rules.visualMessage: Keep your head up and look forward

Weight.name: Weight & Body Composition
Weight.description: Requires steady standing posture, balanced weight distribution, arms hanging relaxed.

rules.name: Stand Straight
rules.description: Torso and legs must be vertically aligned with minimal lateral tilt.
rules.visualMessage: Stand tall and centered on the scale

rules.name: Even Weight Distribution
rules.description: Feet must be shoulder-width apart without leaning heavily to one side.
rules.visualMessage: Distribute your weight evenly on both feet

rules.name: Arms Relaxed at Sides
rules.description: Arms must hang naturally by the sides, not resting on rails.
rules.visualMessage: Keep your arms relaxed at your sides without leaning on rails

ECG.name: ECG Diagnostic Scan
ECG.description: Requires seated, still posture with relaxed arms resting on pads to minimize muscle artifacts.

rules.name: Upright Seated Position
rules.description: Spine upright and supported by chair back.
rules.visualMessage: Sit back comfortably and keep your spine upright

rules.name: Legs Uncrossed & Grounded
rules.description: Legs uncrossed to prevent pelvic torque and baseline wander.
rules.visualMessage: Keep feet flat on the floor and uncross legs

rules.name: Forearms Resting on Electrodes
rules.description: Arms must be resting steadily on sensor pads.
rules.visualMessage: Rest forearms gently on the sensor pads

rules.name: Body Stillness
rules.description: User must remain motionless to prevent electromyographic (EMG) noise.
